questions.question: What is an elevator speech?

answers.text: A formal business presentation lasting 30 minutes
A 30-second pitch covering who you are, what you do, and how you help
answers.textHtml: A 30-second pitch covering who you are, what you do, and how you help

answers.text: A written summary of your business plan
answers.textHtml: A written summary of your business plan

answers.text: A social media post about your services
answers.textHtml: A social media post about your services

questions.feedback: An elevator speech is a concise 30-second pitch that explains who you are, what you do, and how you can solve the listener's problem.
questions.feedbackHtml: Your elevator speech should be a natural, 30-second pitch you can deliver at any time.

questions.question: Why is customer retention more valuable than customer acquisition?
questions.questionHtml: Why is customer retention more valuable than customer acquisition?

answers.text: Existing customers always pay more
It is significantly cheaper to sell to existing customers than to find new ones
answers.textHtml: It is significantly cheaper to sell to existing customers than to find new ones

answers.text: New customers are unreliable
Regulations limit how many new customers you can take
answers.textHtml: Regulations limit how many new customers you can take

questions.feedback: Acquiring new customers requires marketing spend and sales effort. Existing satisfied customers are more likely to buy again and refer others, making retention far more cost-effective.
questions.feedbackHtml: Retention is cheaper than acquisition — satisfied customers buy again and refer others.

questions.question: What should you do first when considering purchasing expensive new drone equipment?
questions.questionHtml: What should you do first when considering purchasing expensive new drone equipment?

answers.text: Buy it immediately to stay competitive
Calculate the return on investment to ensure it will pay for itself
answers.textHtml: Calculate the return on investment to ensure it will pay for itself

answers.text: Ask your competitors what they use
Wait for the next model to be released
answers.textHtml: Wait for the next model to be released

questions.feedback: Always calculate ROI before major purchases. Determine how many jobs it takes to pay off the investment and whether the expected revenue justifies the cost.
questions.feedbackHtml: Calculate ROI before every major purchase to ensure it will generate enough revenue to justify the cost.

questions.question: Select ALL that apply: What should you plan for when thinking about the future of your business?
questions.questionHtml: Select ALL that apply: What should you plan for when thinking about the future of your business?

answers.text: Changing FAA regulations
Potential economic downturns
Expansion of services
Avoiding all risk entirely

questions.feedback: Planning for regulatory changes, economic cycles, and service expansion are all important. Risk cannot be avoided entirely — it must be understood and managed.
questions.feedbackHtml: Plan for regulations, economic cycles, and growth. Risk must be managed, not avoided entirely.

questions.question: What is the most important financial metric to monitor on a daily basis?
questions.questionHtml: What is the most important financial metric to monitor on a daily basis?

answers.text: Total revenue
Cash flow
Number of social media followers
Number of drones owned

questions.feedback: Cash flow is the most critical metric for daily monitoring. Without positive cash flow, your business cannot survive regardless of how profitable it looks on paper.
questions.feedbackHtml: Cash flow is king. Without cash available to pay bills, your business cannot survive.
